snippet.title: Worn By The Forgotten - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Worn By The Forgotten is a 3D puzzle adventure that will test your wits and reflexes. Join Worn on a journey to unveil the hidden secrets of Lethenia! You will navigate through challenging puzzles and survive encounters with relentless enemies hiding in the shadows.

But you are not alone! Take your Divine Beasts and use their abilities to conquer the puzzles and trials ahead of you.

Key Features:

🤝 Unique Single-Player Co-op: Experience the thrill of cooperation all on your own. Seamlessly control and synergize multiple elements to overcome obstacles.

🐾 Command Divine Beasts: Harness the power of mystical Divine Beasts! Take direct control of them to solve intricate 3D puzzles and clear paths that would otherwise be impossible.

🌍 Uncover Forgotten Truths: Throw yourself into a vast, breathtaking landscape. Explore every mysterious corner to unravel the ultimate truth of a world long forgotten!

Follow our development journey!
